place.title: Place {ref} (light sensor)
place.text: Push the photoresistor {ref}'s 2 legs into column f: one into hole {hole.a}, the other into {hole.b}. Its face with the wavy line points up, toward the light.
place.tip: A photoresistor has no + or −: either leg can go in either hole.

why: {ref} is a photoresistor: its resistance drops in bright light. With the 10 kΩ resistor below it, it makes a voltage divider, so the voltage between them rises as the light gets brighter.

wire.ground: This connects the bottom of the divider (the 10 kΩ resistor) to ground.
wire.power: This puts 3.3 V on {ref}'s top leg, the top of the divider.
wire.adc: {pin} is an analog input (ADC): it measures the voltage between {ref} and the 10 kΩ resistor and gives the code a number from 0 to 65535, higher in brighter light.
